main_text.p: Lockis, Capilli: & lockis, capillis] Hæc nobis cum Germanis & superioribus & inferioribus. lockis:eodem sensu Sax. loccar?
Lofen, Dolofum: & lofin, dolofo: & lofonga, dolos] His affine Saxon. læpunʒe, unde nostrum leasing, mendacium.
Los, Sortem] Hoc nobis cum Belg. lot à Sax. ɧlot, & ɧlỳt, fors. Æpenɧlỳtta, consors.
Luzzilon, Parvulis: & luticon, idem] Parvuli Sax. lɪttlinʒar, nobis little ones, quod Germ. superiores, ȝ. pro f. amantes, habent Luzzilon.

Luogindo, Rugiens: & luonde, rugientes, alibi] Ejusdem originis, ac nostrum lotw, aliàs bellotw. Vox fictitia, à sono bovis mugientis, cujus mugitus, Sax. ʒeɧlop. Mugire autem Belg. loten, Ger. lupen.
main_text.head: Verba.
main_text.p: Liconf, Placent: vide Gelliconda: & liconsal, Placebit] Pro geliconda hîc, repone gelicoda, quod vide.
